plugins.name: bugs-bot
plugins.description: A Telegram or Slack bug-report relay for Claude Code: one bot, one group or channel and one agent per project.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare and the local Caddy from a native Claude Code tool: accounts by name, DNS, protections, cache, Workers and Caddy site blocks, with a backup before every write and publish in one command, facading a Python stdlib engine.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub API from a native Claude Code tool: pull requests, review threads, comments, reviews, labels, issues, search and image attachments, facading a Python stdlib engine.

plugins.name: implement
plugins.description: The feature lifecycle as five commands: brainstorm and plan a feature, run its phases, check a delivery, close the branch, prepare the next one.

plugins.name: method
plugins.description: The development method every role follows: the lifecycle, the definition of done, the report, plan and question formats.

plugins.name: norms
plugins.description: Evidence-based code norms: eight review agents, a parallel conformity check, and a learner that turns resolved PR review threads into project rules.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Orchestrate implementer sessions from one supervising session: briefs, evidence-based reviews, agent rotation, succession, terminal tab tooling and a context gauge any session can read.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Interactive PR review workflow: a pending-review walkthrough item by item, GitHub comment processing, and an autonomous review-fix loop.

plugins.name: statusbar
plugins.description: Two-line status bar: directory, git, PR, model, session, context and 5h/7d quotas. No network, no credentials.
